WITH pay AS (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS payment_rows, COUNT(payment_value) AS amount_rows
  FROM main.order_payments GROUP BY order_id
), per_customer AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS ids,
         SUM(p.order_id IS NULL) AS missing_payments,
         SUM(p.payment_rows > 1) AS split_payments,
         SUM(p.amount_rows < p.payment_rows) AS incomplete_payments,
         MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase
  FROM main.orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN pay AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers, SUM(n) AS orders, SUM(n - ids) AS repeated_ids,
       SUM(customer_unique_id IS NULL) AS missing_customers, SUM(n = 1) AS single_order_customers,
       SUM(missing_payments) AS missing_payments, SUM(split_payments) AS split_payments,
       SUM(incomplete_payments) AS incomplete_payments, MAX(last_purchase) AS latest_purchase
FROM per_customer

arguments.sql:
WITH order_spend AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS amount_paid
    FROM main.order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(p.amount_paid) = COUNT(*)
                THEN SUM(p.amount_paid) END AS total_spend
    FROM main.orders AS o
    JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN order_spend AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, total_spend,
           JULIANDAY(MAX(last_purchase) OVER ()) - JULIANDAY(last_purchase) AS recency_days
    FROM customer_totals
),
scores AS (
    -- Score the upper cumulative percentile in fifths. Equal values share a score.
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, total_spend,
           CAST(CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY recency_days)) AS INTEGER) AS r,
           CAST(CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC)) AS INTEGER) AS f,
           CASE WHEN total_spend IS NOT NULL THEN
               CAST(CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY (total_spend IS NULL) ORDER BY total_spend DESC
               )) AS INTEGER)
           END AS m
    FROM customer_metrics
),
segmented AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, total_spend,
           CASE
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
               WHEN r IN (2, 3) AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
               WHEN r = 3 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
               WHEN (r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
                 OR (r = 2 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
               WHEN r = 2 AND f + m BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
               WHEN r = 3 AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
           END AS rfm_segment
    FROM scores
)
SELECT rfm_segment, COUNT(*) AS customers, SUM(order_count) AS orders,
       SUM(total_spend) / SUM(order_count) AS segment_avg
FROM segmented
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY segment_avg DESC

WITH order_spend AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS amount_paid
    FROM main.order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(p.amount_paid) = COUNT(*)
                THEN SUM(p.amount_paid) END AS total_spend
    FROM main.orders AS o
    JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN order_spend AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    -- Elapsed days from each customer's last purchase to the latest purchase among delivered orders.
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, total_spend,
           JULIANDAY(MAX(last_purchase) OVER ()) - JULIANDAY(last_purchase) AS recency_days
    FROM customer_totals
),
scores AS (
    -- Score the upper cumulative percentile in fifths. Equal values share a score.
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, total_spend,
           CAST(CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY recency_days)) AS INTEGER) AS r,
           CAST(CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC)) AS INTEGER) AS f,
           CASE WHEN total_spend IS NOT NULL THEN
               CAST(CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY (total_spend IS NULL) ORDER BY total_spend DESC
               )) AS INTEGER)
           END AS m
    FROM customer_metrics
),
segmented AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, total_spend,
           CASE
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
               WHEN r IN (2, 3) AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
               WHEN r = 3 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
               WHEN (r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
                 OR (r = 2 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
               WHEN r = 2 AND f + m BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
               WHEN r = 3 AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
           END AS rfm_segment
    FROM scores
),
comparison AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, rfm_segment,
           total_spend / order_count AS customer_avg_sales_per_order,
           SUM(total_spend) OVER segment / SUM(order_count) OVER segment
               AS segment_avg_sales_per_order
    FROM segmented
    WINDOW segment AS (PARTITION BY rfm_segment)
)
SELECT rfm_segment, customer_unique_id, customer_avg_sales_per_order,
       segment_avg_sales_per_order,
       segment_avg_sales_per_order - MIN(segment_avg_sales_per_order) OVER ()
           AS difference_from_lowest_segment
FROM comparison
ORDER BY segment_avg_sales_per_order DESC, rfm_segment, customer_unique_id
LIMIT -1

    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    -- Elapsed days from each customer's last purchase to the latest purchase among delivered orders.
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, total_spend,
           JULIANDAY(MAX(last_purchase) OVER ()) - JULIANDAY(last_purchase) AS recency_days
    FROM customer_totals
),
scores AS (
    -- Score the upper cumulative percentile in fifths. Equal values share a score.
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, total_spend,
           CAST(CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY recency_days)) AS INTEGER) AS r,
           CAST(CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC)) AS INTEGER) AS f,
           CASE WHEN total_spend IS NOT NULL THEN
               CAST(CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY (total_spend IS NULL) ORDER BY total_spend DESC
               )) AS INTEGER)
           END AS m
    FROM customer_metrics
),
segmented AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, total_spend,
           CASE
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
               WHEN r IN (2, 3) AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
               WHEN r = 3 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
               WHEN (r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
                 OR (r = 2 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
               WHEN r = 2 AND f + m BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
               WHEN r = 3 AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
           END AS rfm_segment
    FROM scores
),
comparison AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, rfm_segment,
           total_spend / order_count AS customer_avg_sales_per_order,
           SUM(total_spend) OVER segment / SUM(order_count) OVER segment
               AS segment_avg_sales_per_order
    FROM segmented
    WINDOW segment AS (PARTITION BY rfm_segment)
)
SELECT rfm_segment, customer_unique_id, customer_avg_sales_per_order,
       segment_avg_sales_per_order,
       segment_avg_sales_per_order - MIN(segment_avg_sales_per_order) OVER ()
           AS difference_from_lowest_segment
FROM comparison
ORDER BY segment_avg_sales_per_order DESC, rfm_segment, customer_unique_id
LIMIT -1
